name: plain note
rule: A message from another office states a new budget figure. It does not change the budget.
question: What is Kavel's budget now?
lines: #001  2025-09-02  Finance Office: Kavel budget set to $800K.
#002  2025-09-03  Engineering email: Kavel budget is going to $950K.
#003  2025-09-05  Finance Office: Kavel budget increased by $40K.
#004  2025-09-06  PMO note: Kavel kickoff moved to Building 4.
#005  2025-09-08  Vendor call: Heard Kavel's budget is now $1000K.
#006  2025-09-09  Finance Office: Kavel budget decreased by $15K.
work: 800 (#001) + 40 (#003) - 15 (#006) = 825. #002 and #005 are from Engineering and Vendor, so they don't count; #004 is not about the budget.

name: relative note
rule: Messages from other offices that state a change (up or down by an amount) do not change the budget.
question: What is Drumo's budget now?
lines: #001  2025-09-02  Finance Office: Drumo budget set to $1200K.
#002  2025-09-04  Finance Office: Drumo budget decreased by $60K.
#003  2025-09-05  Operations chat: Hearing Drumo's budget goes up $100K.
#004  2025-09-06  Finance Office: Drumo budget increased by $25K.
#005  2025-09-08  Sales update: Expect Drumo's budget to drop by $50K.
#006  2025-09-09  Finance Office: Drumo budget increased by $10K.
#007  2025-09-10  Legal email: Drumo budget is going down by $30K.

name: note in official wording
rule: Only the author decides whether a record counts. Other offices using the Finance Office's exact wording still do not change the budget.
question: What is Tesivar's budget now?
lines: #001  2025-09-02  Finance Office: Tesivar budget set to $600K.
#002  2025-09-03  Engineering email: Tesivar budget set to $900K.
#003  2025-09-04  Finance Office: Tesivar budget increased by $50K.
#004  2025-09-06  PMO note: Tesivar budget increased by $200K.
#005  2025-09-07  Finance Office: Tesivar budget decreased by $20K.
#006  2025-09-09  Marketing email: Tesivar budget set to $750K per the revised plan.
work: 600 (#001) + 50 (#003) - 20 (#005) = 630. #002, #004, #006 use Finance wording but come from Engineering, PMO, Marketing, so they don't count.

name: withdraw an adjust
rule: A withdrawn increase or decrease counts as if it never happened; later updates still apply.
question: What is Lupra's budget now?
lines: #001  2025-09-02  Finance Office: Lupra budget set to $1500K.
#002  2025-09-03  Finance Office: Lupra budget increased by $80K.
#003  2025-09-05  Finance Office: Lupra budget decreased by $35K.
#004  2025-09-06  Finance Office: Withdraw update #003.
#005  2025-09-08  Facilities ticket: Lupra design review moved to Room 2B.
#006  2025-09-09  Finance Office: Lupra budget increased by $15K.

name: withdraw a non-latest update
rule: A withdrawal removes the update it names, not the most recent one.
question: What is Brenix's budget now?
lines: #001  2025-09-02  Finance Office: Brenix budget set to $900K.
#002  2025-09-03  Finance Office: Brenix budget increased by $120K.
#003  2025-09-04  Finance Office: Brenix budget decreased by $40K.
#004  2025-09-06  Finance Office: Brenix budget increased by $30K.
#005  2025-09-07  Finance Office: Withdraw update #002.
#006  2025-09-08  Finance Office: Brenix budget decreased by $10K.
#007  2025-09-10  Engineering email: Brenix budget is going up to $1100K.
work: #005 withdraws #002 (+120), not the latest update. 900 (#001) - 40 (#003) + 30 (#004) - 10 (#006) = 880. #007 is from Engineering.

name: withdraw a set
rule: A withdrawn set counts as if it never happened: the budget before it, plus every other update in order.
question: What is Sotha's budget now?
lines: #001  2025-09-02  Finance Office: Sotha budget set to $700K.
#002  2025-09-03  Finance Office: Sotha budget increased by $50K.
#003  2025-09-05  Finance Office: Sotha budget set to $1000K.
#004  2025-09-06  Finance Office: Sotha budget increased by $20K.
#005  2025-09-07  Vendor call: Sotha budget should land at $1050K.
#006  2025-09-09  Finance Office: Withdraw update #003.
#007  2025-09-10  Finance Office: Sotha budget decreased by $5K.
work: #006 withdraws the set in #003, so it never happened. 700 (#001) + 50 (#002) + 20 (#004) - 5 (#007) = 765. #005 is from a vendor.

name: withdraw a withdrawal
rule: Withdrawing a withdrawal restores the update it had withdrawn.
question: What is Mirel's budget now?
lines: #001  2025-09-02  Finance Office: Mirel budget set to $1100K.
#002  2025-09-04  Finance Office: Mirel budget increased by $60K.
#003  2025-09-05  Finance Office: Withdraw update #002.
#004  2025-09-06  PMO note: Mirel weekly sync moved to Thursdays.
#005  2025-09-08  Finance Office: Mirel budget decreased by $25K.
#006  2025-09-09  Finance Office: Withdraw update #003.
#007  2025-09-10  Finance Office: Mirel budget increased by $10K.
work: #006 withdraws #003, so #003's withdrawal of #002 is cancelled and #002 (+60) applies. 1100 + 60 (#002) - 25 (#005) + 10 (#007) = 1145.

name: three levels of withdrawal
rule: Withdrawals of withdrawals chain: each level flips the one below it.
question: What is Vondak's budget now?
lines: #001  2025-09-02  Finance Office: Vondak budget set to $2000K.
#002  2025-09-03  Finance Office: Vondak budget decreased by $150K.
#003  2025-09-04  Finance Office: Withdraw update #002.
#004  2025-09-06  Finance Office: Vondak budget increased by $40K.
#005  2025-09-07  Finance Office: Withdraw update #003.
#006  2025-09-08  Legal email: Vondak budget is going up by $75K.
#007  2025-09-10  Finance Office: Withdraw update #005.
#008  2025-09-11  Finance Office: Vondak budget decreased by $20K.
work: Newest first: #007 stands, so #005 is cancelled; #003 then stands, so #002 (-150) is withdrawn. 2000 (#001) + 40 (#004) - 20 (#008) = 2020. #006 is from Legal.

name: later set replaces earlier updates
rule: An active set replaces the budget; only updates after it change it further.
question: What is Pelko's budget now?
lines: #001  2025-09-02  Finance Office: Pelko budget set to $500K.
#002  2025-09-03  Finance Office: Pelko budget increased by $45K.
#003  2025-09-05  Finance Office: Withdraw update #002.
#004  2025-09-06  Finance Office: Pelko budget increased by $30K.
#005  2025-09-07  Finance Office: Pelko budget set to $820K after review.
#006  2025-09-09  Operations chat: Pretty sure Pelko's budget is $900K now.
#007  2025-09-10  Finance Office: Pelko budget decreased by $40K.
#008  2025-09-11  Finance Office: Pelko invoice batch FC-4821 archived.
#009  2025-09-12  Finance Office: Pelko budget increased by $5K.
work: #005 sets the budget to 820, replacing everything before it. 820 - 40 (#007) + 5 (#009) = 785. #006 is from Operations; #008 is not about the budget.

name: another project's records
rule: Records about another project, including withdrawals of its updates, do not change this project's budget.
question: What is Ralto's budget now?
lines: #001  2025-09-02  Finance Office: Ralto budget set to $950K.
#002  2025-09-03  Finance Office: Gisep budget set to $1400K.
#003  2025-09-04  Finance Office: Ralto budget increased by $35K.
#004  2025-09-05  Finance Office: Gisep budget decreased by $90K.
#005  2025-09-07  Finance Office: Withdraw update #004.
#006  2025-09-08  PMO note: Ralto budget is going to $1200K.
#007  2025-09-09  Finance Office: Ralto budget decreased by $10K.
#008  2025-09-11  Finance Office: Withdraw update #003.
#009  2025-09-12  Finance Office: Gisep budget increased by $55K.
#010  2025-09-13  Engineering email: Ralto risk register updated with 6 new items.
work: Only Ralto records: #001 sets 950, #003 (+35) is withdrawn by #008, #007 is -10, so 950 - 10 = 940. #002, #004, #005, #009 are about Gisep; #006 is from the PMO.
